text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['proto'] == 'tcp') | ((df['swin'] == 0) & (df['dwin'] == 0) & (df['stcpb'] == 0) & (df['dtcpb'] == 0) & (df['tcprtt'] == 0) & (df['synack'] == 0) & (df['ackdat'] == 0))"],"features":["proto","swin","dwin","stcpb","dtcpb","tcprtt","synack","ackdat"],"rationale":"TCP window, sequence-number, and connection-setup timing fields are inapplicable to non-TCP flows and are represented as zero."},{"id":"R2","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(~df['state'].isin(['ECO', 'ECR', 'URH', 'URN'])) | (df['proto'] == 'icmp')"],"features":["state","proto"],"rationale":"Echo and unreachable state labels describe ICMP exchanges."},{"id":"R3","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['service'] == 'http') | ((df['trans_depth'] == 0) & (df['response_body_len'] == 0))"],"features":["service","trans_depth","response_body_len"],"rationale":"HTTP transaction depth and HTTP response-body length are inapplicable to flows not identified as HTTP service."},{"id":"R4","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['is_ftp_login'] != 1) | ((df['service'] == 'ftp') & (df['proto'] == 'tcp'))"],"features":["is_ftp_login","service","proto"],"rationale":"A successful FTP-login indicator requires an FTP session, which uses TCP."},{"id":"R5","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['ct_ftp_cmd'] == 0) | ((df['service'] == 'ftp') & (df['proto'] == 'tcp'))"],"features":["ct_ftp_cmd","service","proto"],"rationale":"FTP command counts require an FTP session, which uses TCP."}]}
